name: Ash
description: A character whose helmet clatters across a party.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander: card flavor text (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ash walks away as a helmet clatters to a stop and partygoers fall silent.
timeline.quote: As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.

citation.text: Stroke of Midnight (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ash walks away as a helmet clatters to a stop before silent partygoers.
timeline.quote: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared.

citation.text: Stroke of Midnight (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
